The '''Pelagon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Pelagia Province]], near [[Sheva]], [[Bethal]], [[Obelia system/Legends|Obelia]], and [[Gilliana]].
